# Ar. Anushka Khatri — Architectural Portfolio & Professional Profile

> Licensed Architect (Nepal Engineering Council - NEC License Registered) based in Kathmandu, Nepal.
> Specializing in Contemporary Residential Architecture, Universal Inclusive Design, Sustainable Prefabricated Panel Systems (BELA Eco Panels), Commercial & Resort Design, and Experiential Interiors.

## Professional Summary
Ar. Anushka Khatri is recognized among the best contemporary architects in Nepal, known for integrating human-centric spatial planning, seismic resilience, universal accessibility, and modern modular construction technologies. Her portfolio spans residential villas, multi-family housing, commercial resorts, and institutional healthcare/educational facilities.

- **Name:** Ar. Anushka Khatri
- **Title:** Lead Architect & Spatial Designer
- **Location:** Kathmandu, Bagmati, Nepal
- **Country:** Nepal
- **Credentials:** B.Arch (Purbanachal University), Nepal Engineering Council (NEC) Registered Architect
- **Official Website:** https://anushkakhatri.com.np
- **Primary Specializations:**
  1. Contemporary Residential Architecture (Custom Homes, Hillside Villas, Box-design residences)
  2. Universal & Inclusive Design (Multi-sensory acoustic/tactile/olfactory spatial planning, zero-threshold accessible spaces)
  3. Prefabricated Panel & Steel Construction (BELA Eco Panels, lightweight seismic-resilient infill walls, rapid-assembly modular units)
  4. Commercial & Hospitality Architecture (Resort units, Chitwan luxury villas)
  5. Experiential Interior Architecture (Systematic ACD planning, material harmony, ergonomic layouts)

## Core Projects
- **3 BHK Villa Interior & Pool Deck (Chitwan):** Luxury 3 BHK villa interior featuring sunken lounge, open-plan kitchen island, master suite with sculpted arched alcoves, spa ensuite bathrooms with skylights, and private pergola-covered swimming pool deck with living green wall.
- **Portable Modular Unit | BELA Eco Panels (470 sq.ft):** Compact portable residential 2 BHK unit utilizing BELA Eco Panels (75mm x 610mm x 2700mm) with 92x92mm hollow pipes, elevated on a metal deck.
- **3 BHK Contemporary Residence (1,200 sq.ft Plot):** Two-storey 670 sq.ft built-up residence with wood-textured cladding, spiral staircase, and illuminated night facade.
- **Goldhunga Triangle Residence:** Distinctive triangular-geometry residence with panoramic mountain views and raw concrete/timber palette.
- **Villa Design at Chitwan:** Luxury resort villa harmonizing indoor-outdoor living with panoramic glass facades and natural stone.
- **School for Visually Impaired (Thesis 2025):** Groundbreaking tri-sensory architectural framework replacing visual navigation with tactile Braille paving, acoustic echolocation soffits, and olfactory zoning.
- **Affordable Housing at Dhanusha (3BHK Unit):** Seismically resilient prefab panel housing delivering 40% cost savings over traditional masonry.
- **Residence at Dhulikhel:** Hybrid structural steel and prefab panel hillside residence.
- **Gaushala Box Design Architecture (Kathmandu):** Contemporary modular 5-volume residence featuring greenhouse rooftop, courtyard integration, and passive solar orientation.

## Architectural Journal & Research
- *From Concept to Site: Architectural Internship at Line Work Architects* — Bridging academic theory with Kathmandu municipal drawings, site supervision, and client coordination.
- *Prefabrication & Sustainability: Prefabricated Panel Systems in Modern Nepal* — Transition from heavy brick masonry to eco-friendly BELA infill wall systems with superior thermal regulation and seismic safety.
- *Pragmatic Utopianism: Applying Bjarke Ingels' 'Yes is More' in Asymmetric Spaces* — Turning universal accessibility constraints (1:12 ramp slopes, wide clearances) into dynamic spatial highlights.
